en: Black‑and‑white waterfront view of a small Nordic coastal town. In the foreground are wooden piers and boathouses on stilts along calm water. Behind them stands a large, modernist seaside building with long balconies and awnings, identified as a bathing restaurant or bathhouse, surrounded by smaller wooden houses climbing a rocky hillside. Several flagpoles with Nordic flags fly above the buildings. Printed caption text appears at the lower left and a small publisher's logo and number at the lower right.
